text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Top Road-senpai is seriously amazing after 
all~...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what? Why are you acting so formal 
all of a sudden...!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's something I've always thought! 
Everyone relies on you, and you always 
meet their expectations... It's really 
amazing."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
She has so many friends, a wonderful 
smile, and just makes you feel warm 
inside... I want to become someone like 
Top Road-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh!? Th-That's... such an honor! Thank 
you very much!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Still, you have plenty of friends too, 
Dantsu-chan. You're always so considerate, 
and you have such a lovely smile...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. Dantsu-chan is truly amazing 
after all! Just so, um... amazing, I 
think!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"N-No way! Being praised by Top 
Road-senpai makes me blush...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I-I feel the exact same way. To receive 
praise from such a wonderful Umamusume 
like you, Dantsu-chan...!
